tara.m: FYI - CardinalCare booked a security precall for Fri 10:30am ET. They want a short evidence pack: RBAC snapshots, signed audit export, KMS BYOK proof, and our vuln triage timeline. Can we compile a minimal bundle?
noah.k: I can do RBAC snapshots. They asked for monthly snapshots for the last 6 months plus a realtime diff for last 30 days. Do we have an automated snapshot job?
maria.c: We run daily RBAC audit events; snapshotting is a small job. Owner: noah.k to generate tarball + manifest. Include md5 checksums and signer metadata.
kevin.s: I'll prepare the signed audit export. Plan: sanitize PII, salt+hash emails, sign manifest with redwood-svc-key-v4. Example manifest line: `rbac-snapshot-2025-05-01.tar.gz, sha256:deadbeef..., signed-by: redwood-svc-key-v4`
sarah.ops: For hosted tenants we stream audit events to Splunk over HEC. CardinalCare is on Splunk enterprise on-prem; they'll want sample HEC JSON and guidance for mapping indices. I'll create two sample events and a mapping snippet.
sec-bot: Precall checklist: ensure exports redact PII, confirm MFA enforced on admin roles, attach last 90 days of RBAC alerts, and include a copy of our IR SLA.
tara.m: KMS/BYOK question: they operate a customer-managed key in Azure Key Vault. They want to know how we do envelope encryption and whether we record KMS key wrap/unwrapped events.
noah.k: We store envelope metadata in audit_events and emit KMS audit entries (wrap/unwrap) to the same pipeline. I'll add sample KMS event lines (timestamp + key_id + operation + request_id) with redaction of any secrets.
kevin.s: Example KMS event JSON:```json
{ "ts": "2025-05-02T08:12:34Z", "event": "kms.decrypt", "key_id": "arn:azure:keyvault:...:key/cc-01", "request_id": "req-1234abcd", "result": "success" }
```
sarah.ops: For SIEM mapping: recommend cardinal map `rbac.role_change` -> `user.identity.change`, include `orig_audit_id` so they can correlate. Severity is INFO for routine role changes, HIGH for admin removal/add.
tara.m: Incident response asks: what artifacts do we provide for a P1? They expect timeline and what evidence we share.\e (typo) ignore
maria.c: Our standard: initial notification within 30m, acknowledge 1h, containment plan within 4h, IR package (timeline, logs, indicators, postmortem) within 72h. We can commit to that for enterprise customers with response add-on.
kevin.s: Vulnerability triage process: we run CVSS triage, business-impact scoring, map to remediation owner, and schedule mitigations in the next sprint if P2+. I'll draft a short one-pager.
noah.k: Upload plan: I will put RBAC snapshots + diff csv in secure-share and post link. Will include a small script to compute diffs. Snippet:```bash
# generate diff between snapshots
diff -u snapshot-2025-04-01.csv snapshot-2025-05-01.csv > rbac-diff-202505.patch
```
sarah.ops: I'll add Splunk HEC samples and an ingestion checklist. Also note the retention guidance: advertised default 18 months for audit events; we can extend for Private installs.
tara.m: Who will join the call? need an on-call and someone who owns KMS. Kevin and Noah please join.
kevin.s: I'll join. Also propose we do prepared artifacts only, no live demo unless requested.
noah.k: Agreed. Prepared artifacts + sanitized samples.
sec-bot: Reminder: confirm that salt used for hashing emails is stored in secret manager and rotate policy is documented.
maria.c: I'll draft the one-pager (scope, artifacts list, timeline, contacts) and circulate before EOD. Team, ping this thread when uploads are done. :white_check_mark:
